value.rationale: The 64 quartic-coset triples form the complete natural three-term correlation invariant of the index-four multiplicative quotient. Identifying all exceptional primes and distinct final obstructions at 709 versus 1153 gives two sharp universal thresholds 733 and 1181, finer than general sufficiently-large existence and pair results. These are exact motivated arithmetic cutoffs, not arbitrary parameter slices.
